entities.summary: Francisco Alexandre Stockinger, also known as Chico Stockinger, was an Austrian artist and naturalized Brazilian. In addition to his sculpture, Stockinger was also an active printmaker, photographer, cartoonist, and graphic artist. Stockinger arrived in Brazil in 1921 and became a resident of São Paulo in 1929. Stockinger was chairman of the Francisco Lisboa Rio Grande do Sul Association for the Visual Arts from 1957 to 1978.
